Date: 2021-09-02 WHAT IS CLAIMED IS:
1. A flexible electrode comprising:
a fibrous substrate comprised of a nonwoven mass of polymeric nanofibers, the substrate having at least one contact and an electrode interface, and
electrically conductive traces formed on the fibrous substrate providing electrical communications between the at least one contact and the electrode interface.
2. The flexible electrode according to claim 1, wherein the fibrous substrate exhibits an elastic modulus of between about 50 MPa to about 5 GPa.
3. The flexible electrode according to claim 1, wherein the polymeric nanofibers are formed of a plastic material selected from the group consisting of nylon, polycaprolactone, cellulose acetate, poly(methyl-methacrylate, ethylene vinyl alcohol and polyimide.
4. The flexible electrode according to claim 3, wherein the polymeric nanofibers are formed of nylon-6 and/or nylon-6,12.
5. The flexible electrode according to claim 1, further comprising a stabilizing cuff attached to a proximal portion of the fibrous substrate.
6. The flexible electrode according to claim 1, further comprising a support fiber attached axially to the fibrous substrate.
7. The flexible electrode according to claim 6, wherein the support fiber is formed of a high strength polymeric material.
8. The flexible electrode according to claim 7, wherein the high strength polymeric material comprises high density polyethylene or polyaramid.
9. The flexible electrode according to claim 2, wherein the substrate comprises a nanofiber layer which includes the polymeric nanofibers and an insulation layer.
10. The flexible electrode according to claim 9, wherein the insulation layer comprises a p-xylyene polymer or polydimethysiloxane.
11. The flexible electrode according to claim 1, wherein the substrate comprises an electrically conductive polymer or metal component.
12. The flexible electrode according to claim 11, wherein the electrically conductive polymer component comprises poly(3,4- ethylenedioxythiophene) polystyrene sulfate or vapor phase polymerized poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene).
13. The flexible electrode according to claim 11, wherein the electrically conductive polymer component comprises conductively doped nanofibers formed of polycaprolactone, cellulose acetate, poly(methyl-methacrylate) or ethylene vinyl alcohol.
14. The flexible electrode according to claim 11, wherein the fibrous substrate is coated with a conductive metallic component.
15. The flexible electrode according to claim 2, wherein the polymeric nanofibers comprise an insulating coating.
16. The flexible electrode according to claim 14, wherein the insulating coating comprises p-xylyene polymer or polydimethylsiloxane.
17. A method of making a flexible electrode comprising the steps of:
(a) electrospinning a fibrous substrate layer comprised of a nonwoven mass of polymeric nanofibers;
(b) depositing a conductive component on or within the fibrous substrate layer; and
(c) photolithographically forming electrical traces on or within the fibrous substrate layer.
18. The method according to claim 17, which further comprises the step of :
(d) coating the substrate layer and electrical traces with a silicone layer; and thereafter (e) etching regions of the silicone layer to form contact points.
19. The method according to claim 18, which further comprises the step of:
(f) forming a final shape of the electrode.
20. The method according to claim 17, wherein step (b) comprises applying a photoresist material onto the substrate layer and etching conductive channel patterns.
21. The method according to claim 20, wherein step (b) comprises incorporating an electrically conductive material in the channel patterns. 37 38 39 40
